final: WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_patient_hgb FROM patient_averages), above_average AS (SELECT p.ID, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_hgb - o.avg_patient_hgb AS difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE p.avg_hgb > o.avg_patient_hgb), mean_difference AS (SELECT AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM above_average) SELECT a.ID, a.avg_hgb, a.difference, a.avg_hgb - m.avg_difference AS difference_from_mean FROM above_average AS a CROSS JOIN mean_difference AS m ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC LIMIT 10
